items.title: End of the 'Lag 7'? What Nvidia's earnings mean for the rest of tech.
items.summary: Slatestone Wealth Chief Market Strategist Kenny Polcari, F.L. Putnam Investment Management Co. Chief Market Strategist and Portfolio Manager Ellen Hazen, and Prime Capital Financial Chief Investment Officer Will McGough join Yahoo Finance's Brooke DiPalma to discuss Nvidia's (NVDA) latest earnings report, concerns about circular financing, and whether it's the end of the Magnificent Seven's lackluster performance.

items.title: Cramer Says the Bears Spent Months Lying About Salesforce and Nvidia. One Earnings Report Just Ended It.
items.summary: Bears spent months building a case that AI would hollow out Salesforce and eventually topple Nvidia, and then a single earnings night arrived and put both arguments on trial at once.

items.title: Wall Street Bulls Look Optimistic About Salesforce (CRM): Should You Buy?
items.summary: Based on the average brokerage recommendation (ABR), Salesforce (CRM) should be added to one's portfolio. Wall Street analysts' overly optimistic recommendations cast doubt on the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric. So, is the stock worth buying?

items.title: AI Isn’t Eating SaaS: Why Salesforce and ServiceNow Finally Exploded Upward
items.summary: Investors spent months betting that AI would cannibalize enterprise software giants, but Salesforce and ServiceNow just reported quarters that turned that fear inside out. The question now is whether these results signal a permanent reversal or just a temporary reprieve.
